text: The Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Property Standards Committee. The Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment.

The Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee : 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Property Standards Committee: Candidate PSC2-146 Candidate PSC2-199 Candidate PSC2-215 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 to 4 to the report (February 15, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Property Standards Committee.
